entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Oh! Perfect timing. You got a sec?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Cool. I just wanted to give you[n]something.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Don't worry, not gonna make it weird.[n]Just... If Sojiro saw, he'd get ideas and[n]start freaking out.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: A chocolatey gift. For my friend and[n]squadmate.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: If you wanna pay me back, I'll take[n]a year's supply of instant noodles.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: What, you thought I was serious?[n]Relax! It's just a gift from me to you.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Cause you're my key item, right?[n]And you always will be!
